turn.title: Blade-model turn analysis
turn.subtitle: Speed × pitch rate q · current blade configuration
turn.tooltip: A quasi-steady estimate from the current Besiege blade model, interpreting pitch rate q as turn rate after approximately 90° bank. It is not maximum or sustained turn performance.
turn.helpRate: Higher |q| means faster direction change after the aircraft banks.
turn.helpRadius: At the same speed, larger |q| corresponds to a smaller kinematic radius.
turn.helpMomentZero: Pitch moment = 0 means only rotational-moment equilibrium in the blade model.
turn.helpPower: Blade power ΣF·v shows the game-specific energy behavior of Besiege aerodynamic blades.
turn.estimateNote: q_eq is linearly interpolated from the Pitch moment = 0 contour. If multiple crossings exist, the branch nearest the current q is used. R = V / |q_eq|. No inertia, control input, bank dynamics, or translational force balance is modeled.
